_readme: TEMPLATE ONLY — these are illustrative questions written for this file, not
real previous year questions. Delete this file before importing real data.
Drop --dry-run to actually write. Re-running the same file is safe: rows are
upserted on a hash of the question text, so nothing duplicates.
'topic' is the field the AI paper generator learns from. A question with no
topic still shows in the PYQ list but contributes nothing to the pattern, so
fill it in with the same topic names your syllabus uses.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A solid sphere of mass \( M \) and radius \( R \) rolls without slipping down an incline of angle \( \theta \). What is the acceleration of its centre of mass?
questions.solution: For a rolling solid sphere \( I = \tfrac{2}{5}MR^2 \), so \( a = \frac{g\sin\theta}{1 + I/MR^2} = \frac{5}{7}g\sin\theta \).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: The half-life of a first order reaction is 30 minutes. What fraction of the reactant remains after 90 minutes?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: Evaluate \( \int_{0}^{1} \frac{2x}{1+x^2}\,dx \). Give your answer to two decimal places.
